transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling cardholder services. My name is Marcus. May I have your full name, please?
Customer: Hi Marcus, this is Leon Abernathy. I have got two big problems on my card right now that I need taken care of immediately.
Agent: Hello, Mr. Abernathy. I can certainly help you look into your account. First, could you please verify the last four digits of your card and your mailing address?
Customer: Sure, the last four are 8812, and my address is 442 North Elm Street.
Agent: Thank you for verifying that. Go ahead and tell me what is going on with the card.
Customer: Well, both of these things are a mess. First, I went to Harvest Table Market and bought groceries, but that two hundred and twenty dollars is on my account two times. And just as urgent, I ordered a backpack from Trailhead Gear for one hundred and forty-five dollars, and the thing has never arrived.
Agent: All right, I am noting both of those down. Let's start with Harvest Table Market. Do you know what date that transaction took place?
Customer: That was on September 12th. I was only at the checkout once, paid two hundred and twenty dollars, but when I looked at my card activity, the exact same charge is sitting there twice.
Agent: Have you reached out to Harvest Table Market about the extra charge on that date?
Customer: I tried calling the store manager twice, but nobody ever picked up or called me back.
Agent: Okay, I have that down. Now regarding Trailhead Gear, what was the date of that order?
Customer: I ordered it right around the same time, September 12th. It was a one hundred and forty-five dollar daypack.
Agent: Did Trailhead Gear provide you with a shipping update or an expected delivery date for the backpack?
Customer: They sent an order confirmation saying it would take five business days. The tracking link never updated after that, and the box never showed up at my house.
Agent: Have you attempted to contact Trailhead Gear about the missing delivery?
Customer: I sent two messages through their website contact form asking where my package is, and I haven't heard a single word back from them.
Agent: All right, Mr. Abernathy. Just to summarize what you've shared so far, you have a two hundred and twenty dollar charge from Harvest Table Market on September 12th that is showing up twice, and you also have an order from Trailhead Gear for one hundred and forty-five dollars for merchandise that was never delivered, with no response from either merchant.
Customer: Yes, that is exactly what happened with both of them.
